This post is from the blog I kept as Preceptor in Mathematics at Harvard (2005–2008). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.
:::

Serena Rezny is speaking this week in the [Undergraduate Mathematics Colloquium aka Math Table](http://math.harvard.edu/mathtable/index.html) on laundry machines. Sounds like a fun practical math application that all undergraduates could learn from. Serena is the four-time [π day](http://www.math.harvard.edu/piday/index_2007.html) recitation champion, having reached 1058 digits this most recent March 14.![](http://www.math.harvard.edu/piday/2007/serena.jpg)\
